description: A dashboard that monitors Vault. It is created using the [vault-mixin](https://github.com/adinhodovic/vault-mixin). For an in-depth view of Go runtime internals (CPU, memory, GC, scheduling, contention, file descriptor pressure), pair this dashboard with the [Go / Overview dashboard](https://grafana.com/grafana/dashboards/25063-go-overview/) from the [go-mixin](https://github.com/adinhodovic/go-mixin) project.

panels.title: Unsealed Nodes
panels.description: Vault nodes that are unsealed: red when none is.

panels.title: Total Nodes
panels.description: Vault nodes reporting the sealed gauge.

panels.title: Active Leader
panels.description: Nodes that are the active leader: exactly 1 is fine.

panels.title: Scrape Up
panels.description: Vault targets Prometheus scrapes successfully.

panels.title: Active Leases
panels.description: Leases currently tracked by the expiration manager.

panels.title: Irrevocable Leases
panels.description: Leases Vault cannot revoke: any is worth a look.

panels.title: In-Flight Requests
panels.description: Requests Vault is handling right now.

panels.title: Available Tokens
panels.description: Tokens currently valid, across auth methods.

panels.title: Success Rate
panels.description: Share of responses that were not 5xx.

panels.title: Sealed
panels.description: Per node, whether Vault is sealed or unsealed over time.

panels.title: Active Node
panels.description: Per node, whether it is the active leader or a standby over time.

panels.title: Response Rate by Type
panels.description: Responses per second by status class, as a share.

panels.title: Response Rate by Type
panels.description: Responses per second by status class, stacked.

panels.title: Response Success Rate
panels.description: Share of responses that were not 5xx.

panels.title: Mount Entries by Type
panels.description: Entries in the mount table by secrets engine or auth method type.

panels.title: Mount Table Size by Type
panels.description: Size of the mount table by type.

panels.title: Autopilot Healthy
panels.description: Whether Raft autopilot reports the cluster healthy over time.

panels.title: Autopilot Failure Tolerance
panels.description: Failures the cluster can lose and stay available: 0 means no margin.

panels.title: Autopilot Node Healthy
panels.description: Per Raft node, whether autopilot reports it healthy over time.

panels.title: Replication Status
panels.description: Replication roles (DR and performance, primary and secondary) over time; Yes means the node has that role.

panels.title: Leadership Changes
panels.description: Rate of leadership lost and step-down events: should stay at zero.

panels.title: Raft Commit Time (p99)
panels.description: p99 time to commit a Raft log entry.

panels.title: Raft Apply Rate
panels.description: Raft log entries applied per second.

panels.title: Raft Peer Indexes
panels.description: Commit and applied Raft index per peer: a peer that lags is behind the leader.

panels.title: Raft FSM Pending
panels.description: Raft FSM entries waiting to be applied, per peer.

panels.title: Raft Bolt Page Bytes by Database
panels.description: Page bytes allocated by each Raft Bolt database.

panels.title: Raft Bolt Free Pages
panels.description: Free pages on the Bolt freelist, per database.

panels.title: Raft Bolt Write Count
panels.description: Bolt write count, per database.

panels.title: Raft Bolt Write Time Rate
panels.description: Time spent writing to Bolt per second, per database.

panels.title: Request Rate
panels.description: Requests and login requests handled per second.

panels.title: Request Latency
panels.description: Request handling latency, p50 and p99.

panels.title: Route Read Rate
panels.description: Reads per second per route.

panels.title: Route Read Latency
panels.description: Mean read latency per route.

panels.title: Available Tokens
panels.description: Tokens currently valid, across auth methods.

panels.title: Tokens by Auth Method
panels.description: Tokens currently valid, by auth method.

panels.title: Token Operations
panels.description: Token creation, create count, store and lookup operations per second.

panels.title: Audit Log Requests
panels.description: Audit log requests and responses written per second.

panels.title: Audit Log Failures
panels.description: Audit log write failures per second: any is red, since Vault blocks without a working audit device.

panels.title: Policy Get Rate
panels.description: Policy reads per second.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: Memory allocated by the Go runtime and obtained from the system.

panels.title: Goroutines
panels.description: Goroutines in the Vault process.

panels.title: Process CPU
panels.description: CPU seconds used per second by the Vault process.

panels.title: Open FD Usage
panels.description: Open file descriptors as a share of the limit: amber from 70, red from 90.

panels.title: Process Resident Memory
panels.description: Resident memory of the Vault process.

panels.title: Cache Hit Rate
panels.description: Cache hits per second.

title: Vault / Overview
